context:
Answered in chat to the session-messaging topic session, 09:34 CST Nov 10: the mailbox design must not depend on the device. Your local computer may be a Windows work laptop or a personal Mac: "the device I use shouldn't matter".

You asked whether "Mac" was recorded falsely. It was not wrong but too narrow: it named the only computer measured so far (task 294). The decision is reworded on branch mailbox-one-route, and step session-mailbox-followups now says "a session on the owner's computer, Mac or Windows" and runs the trial on a Mac and on a Windows PC.
title: The session mailbox design does not depend on which computer you use
